title: Basis on which Spendable Points are Credited to a Wanderlane Traveller Club Card
content:
Spendable points accrue to a Wanderlane Traveller Club card at the earn rate of the tier held on the day the activity is booked, measured against the money actually paid for it, with taxes, third-party fees and agency service fees excluded from the measure.

## The measure and the credit

The base accrual is the money so measured multiplied by the earn rate of the tier held. The tier bonus is applied on top of the base accrual as a percentage of it: it is the base accrual multiplied by the tier's bonus percentage, rounded to the nearest whole point. The tier bonus is the only multiplier applied. Two promotions never multiply one another; the larger of the two is taken.

Activity with an earning partner accrues at the partner rate of the tier held, applied as a percentage of the platform rate: the rate applied to that activity is the tier's platform earn rate taken at the tier's partner percentage. A tier that does not permit partner earning accrues nothing from partner activity.

**Worked example on hypothetical figures.** Take a card whose earn rate is 7 points to the US dollar and whose tier bonus stands at 20 per cent, both figures chosen for this example only. Activity is booked on which 253.00 US dollars is actually paid once taxes, third-party fees and the agency service fee have been excluded from the measure. The base accrual is that 253.00 multiplied by 7, giving 1771 points. The tier bonus is that same 1771 taken at 20 per cent, which is 354.2 points before rounding and 354 points rounded to the nearest whole point. The card is credited 1771 points of base accrual and a further 354 points of tier bonus.

## When a card accrues at all

Points accrue only while the membership record stands at applied, active or suspended. The membership record is the authority for this, and it must stand at one of those three before the credit is raised against that membership.

| The membership record stands at | Points accrue |
|---|---|
| applied | Yes |
| active | Yes |
| suspended | Yes |
| lapsed | No |
| closed | No |

## Bonuses outside the earn rate

The milestone bonus is paid once in a qualifying period, at the moment the milestone threshold is passed, and is not paid again if the count later falls back. The birthday bonus is paid once a membership year. The referral bonus is paid on each enrolled referral up to the tier's annual cap, and a referral that never activates is not paid.

## Purchased points

Purchased points accrue nothing further. They arrive spendable, they do not earn the tier bonus, and they never count toward qualification.
